items.a: Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser. Your files never leave your device and are not uploaded, stored, or shared.

items.q: Do I need my Instagram password?
items.a: No. You don't need to log in or connect your account. You only use files that you download directly from Meta.

items.q: Why do I need to download files from Meta?
items.a: Instagram doesn't provide this information directly. By using your exported data, we can accurately compare your followers and following lists.
About 5 minutes to request and download your data from Meta, and just a few seconds to process it here.

howItWorks.meta: No login required · Runs locally · Takes less than 5 minutes

steps.title: Request your data from Meta
steps.description: Go to your account settings and request your data export. This usually takes a few minutes.

steps.title: Download followers & following files
steps.description: Once ready, download your data and locate the followers and following files.

steps.title: Upload and get your results
steps.description: Upload the files into the tool and instantly see who doesn't follow you back.

faq.subtitle: Still have questions? Here's everything you need to know.

items.q: What files do I need exactly?
items.a: You need the followers and following files from your Meta account export. The step-by-step guide above shows exactly where to find them.
Your exported data includes complete lists of who you follow and who follows you. By comparing both lists locally, we can identify who doesn't follow you back.

items.q: What format should the files be in?
items.a: The tool supports the JSON format provided by Meta. Just download the files as instructed in the guide.

items.q: Can I use this on mobile?
items.a: Yes, but using a desktop is recommended for a smoother experience when downloading and uploading files.

items.q: Is any of my data sent to a server?
items.a: No. All processing happens locally in your browser. Your data stays on your device at all times.

items.q: Can you access my Instagram account?
items.a: No. This tool has no access to your account. It only reads the files you manually provide.

items.q: What if my files don't work?
items.a: Make sure you downloaded the correct files from Meta and didn't modify them. If the issue persists, try downloading them again.

items.q: Why not just use an app for this?
items.a: Most apps require login access to your account. This tool avoids that completely by using your own exported data, making it safer and more private.

about.title: About this project
about.description: A simple way to check who doesn't follow you back.

what.title: About unfollowz
what.description: unfollowz is a tool that helps you identify who doesn't follow you back on Instagram. It works by comparing two lists from your own exported Meta data: followers and following.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.description: Your data never leaves your device. Everything runs locally in your browser. This means no uploads, no servers, and no third-party access.

points.noAccess: No access to your Instagram account

how.title: How it works
how.description: Instagram doesn't show who doesn't follow you back. However, your exported data includes complete lists of your followers and who you follow. This tool compares both lists locally and calculates the difference to identify non-followers.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: This project is designed to be simple and transparent. There is no tracking or unnecessary complexity.
transparency.warning: If a tool asks for your password, you should question it.
